content:
Jules (AE): Heads-up: EdgeCorp exec bridge requested — last-mile failures on POC. They want deterministic websocket throughput + BYOK. Bridge 2026-05-10 14:00 CEST. Need a validation plan and price delta for private/VPC.

Marco (SE): Short Qs: are clients streaming per-token? expected concurrency? model variant?

Jules (AE): Token streaming, ~500 concurrent websockets, bursts ~900 qps. Using redwood-13b-opt.

Asha (Infra): For private/VPC we should size 4 x A10G; need peering, control-plane certs, and HSM integration checklist. I'll produce a checklist.

Marco (SE): I'll provide a lightweight load harness and run a smoke test against staging. Acceptance draft: p99 token latency <120ms, drop rate <0.5% over 15m.

Priya (Legal): They require SCCs/DPA + subprocessors list. BYOK on-prem increases redlines; I'll prep a short DPA redline for the bridge.

Ravi (CRO): Commercially they asked 30% off. Our standard private commit is 20% + 2 months free; CRO can approve 25% for 12mo ARR threshold. I'll join bridge.

meeting-bot: "EdgeCorp exec bridge" created for 2026-05-10 14:00 CEST. Invites sent.

Jules (AE): Action items: Marco -> harness + smoke run (EOD), Asha -> infra checklist + cost est (EOD), Priya -> DPA draft (EOD). Update thread when ready. :thumbsup:
